contents.content:
Kalyani Tech Park is located in two significant locations in Brookfield and JP Nagar. The park offers perfectly maintained office spaces that satisfy the needs of MNCs and IT companies due to its ideal location and cutting-edge facilities. The Kalyani Tech Parks are highly praised for its avant-garde facilities and act as a hub of innovation and productivity in an otherwise hectic cityscape. Kalyani Tech Park in Brookfield, one of the well-established residential and commercial centers in Bangalore, with green-certified buildings made up of high-performance, sustainable, energy-efficient working environments. Some of its giant occupants include SAP, HP, and Mphasis, making it a significant IT hub. Kalyani Tech Park offers convenience along with modern infrastructure and amenities in proximity to Whitefield and connectivity to key areas of Bangalore.

Kalyani Tech Park is an IT hub in Brookefield, Bangalore. With more and more people looking for housing closer to the area, knowing the best localities near Kalyani Tech Park becomes essential. The article sheds light on several neighborhoods that have a mix of convenience, luxuries, and lifestyles for residents

Key Takeaways 

  • Proximity to IT hubs: Kalyani Tech Park allows easy access to top technology companies.

  • Diverse localities: Brookefield, Whitefield, Kundalahalli, Varthur, and Marathahalli offer residents the most preferred localities.

  • Lifestyle amenities: Each locality is so unique in its offerings in terms of schools, parks, etc.

 Why Choose to Stay Near Kalyani Tech Park?  

Choosing to live near Kalyani Tech Park has numerous benefits. The area is not just about work; it also offers a vibrant lifestyle. Here are some compelling reasons to consider:

  • Proximity to Work: The close distance to major IT companies reduces commuting time significantly. For many professionals, this means more time for family or leisure activities.

  • Excellent Connectivity:Adequate road network and public transport system facilitate smooth commuting. The residents can easily reach various parts of Bangalore

  • Lifestyle Amenities: Kalyani Tech Park is close to several shopping malls, restaurants, parks, and play areas along with recreational activities for daily life.

    1.Brookefield

Brookefield is one of the most in-demand localities near Kalyani Tech Park. The area is a neighborhood in Bangalore created way back during the late 19th century as a settlement for the Eurasians of Bangalore. It is luxurious and rich as new commercial roads are sprouting in—ITPL road, decent cost of living, and affordable real estate prices. It is a prime locality and a posh area with many residential projects and leading MNCs in its vicinity.
It forms a part of the Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike (BBMP) as its municipal authority and is very well connected to Whitefield, Hoodi, Marathahalli, and Doddannekundi. Brookfield is an Eastern Bangalore neighborhood that is predominantly residential and commercial, having equal ease of access to social amenities and dominated by multistorey apartments.

Average Rent of 1 BHK In Brookefield: ₹13,000-₹23,000
Average Rent of 2 BHK In Brookefield -₹25,000-₹35,000

Lifestyle Amenities:

  • Shopping malls like Brookefield Mall, Phoenix Marketcity
  • Numerous restaurants offering diverse cuisines.
  • Nearby Schools.Ryan International School, Narayana E Techno School.
  • Healthcare: Brookefield Hospital, Sankara Eye Hospital.

2. Whitefield

The other major attraction for the employees working from Kalyani Tech Park is Whitefield. It has grown into one of the vibrant neighborhoods with everything that one would require. Whitefield, first settled in 1882 as a neighborhood for the Eurasians and Anglo Indians of Bangalore, remained a quaint little neighborhood at the eastern periphery of the city until the late 1990s. This is when the local IT industry became a major suburb. It now comprises an enormous part of Bengaluru. Whitefield is the first IT corridor in Bengaluru to have a Namma Metro connection.
It has hundreds of IT companies, tech parks, and businesses, making it a prominent IT hub in the locality. It offers employment opportunities to citizens from all over the nation and the world. People working in IT parks located in the area and along the IT corridor of the Outer Ring Road (ORR) like to stay in Whitefield.

Average Rent of  1 BHK In Whitefield: ₹10,000-₹20,000
Average Rent of  2 BHK In Whitefield: ₹25,000-₹40,000

Lifestyle Amenities:

  • High-end shopping malls like Park Square Mall, Nexus Shantiniketan, Nexus Whitefield.
  • A variety of dining options from street food to fine dining.
  • Good educational institutions such as International School Bangalore, Vydehi School of Excellence.
  • Healthcare: Manipal Hospital, Cloudnine Hospital.

3. Kundalahalli

Kundalahalli is an emerging locality that offers a quieter lifestyle while still remaining close to the tech park. Kundalahalli is a well-developed locality situated in the eastern suburban region of Bengaluru. It is an ideal locality to live amidst green surroundings. It is located close to EPIP Zone, Brookfield, and Kundalahalli Colony. Hoodi railway station, Kundalahalli metro station, Munekolala bus stand, and Nallurahalli metro station provide seamless connectivity to Kundalahalli. Kundalahalli is among the well-thought-out localities in Bengaluru. It is the best rental destination for tech people working at Marathahalli and Whitefield, as both locations are just near from Kundalahalli. Kundalahalli has a few upcoming projects like the metro Phase-2 route between Kundalahalli and Whitefield station, which would be a demand driver for real estate. The Kundalahalli Underpass has also smoothened traffic flow to Marathahalli and Whitefield.

Average Rent of 1 BHK In Kundalahalli-₹16,000- ₹25,000.
Average Rent of 2 BHK In Kundalahalli-₹30,000-₹45,000.

Lifestyle Amenities:

  • Shopping malls:Brookefield Mall,Park Square Mall
  • A wide selection of dining experiences, ranging from street food to gourmet cuisine.
  • Good Schools:Gopalan International School,EuroSchool Whitefield
  • Healthcare:Aayug Multi Speciality Hospital

4. Varthur

Varthur is known to have a peaceful environment, and it suits families looking for space in homes. Varthur is a suburb of Bangalore, Karnataka, India that is experiencing an uprising in growth. The suburb borders Varthur Lake, where people go for bird-watching, amongst other activities. The city has undergone numerous developments in residential and commercial projects contributing to its amazing growth and development. Because of this, Varthur's infrastructure has improved and the population has grown. Varthur also faces several difficulties, such as heavy rush hour traffic, no water in the summer, and Varthur Lake pollution. Local government agencies and citizen organizations are working to stop these problems and raise the general standard of living in the area.

Average Rent of 1 BHK In Varthur-₹10,000- ₹20,000
Average Rent of 2 BHK In Varthur-₹25,000-₹35,000

Lifestyle Amenities:

  • Shopping malls: Nexus Whitefield, Brookefield Mall
  •  A range of dining choices, from street food to upscale restaurants.
  • Good Schools:Vydehi School of Excellence, The Bangalore School
  • Healthcare: Narayana Multispeciality Hospital, Motherhood Hospital

5. Marathahalli

Marathahalli is an active neighborhood in the eastern part of Bangalore, Karnataka, India. It falls on the outer ring road and former airport road and is very ideal for resident and business purposes. Marathahalli is famous for its very active and diverse neighborhood and proximity to many IT parks, commercial centers, shopping malls, restaurants, and lots more attractions. In the last few years, the locality has increased rapidly, with several new residential and commercial complexes rising to accommodate the emerging demand. Thus, Marathahalli is a vibrant and very busy neighborhood that affords the pleasant juxtaposition of both urban accessibility and rural tranquility.

Marathahalli is a bustling, diverse town on Bangalore's eastern fringe, offering a great mix of urban convenience and suburban calm. Strategically placed between the outer ring road and the former airport road, the region is very popular as a residential and commercial destination. Marathahalli is very active because IT companies, business facilities, shopping malls, and eateries abound there. The neighborhood is well connected with the rest of the city, and its proximity to Bangalore International Airport adds to its appeal. Marathahalli, with rapid expansion and progress, offers a fantastic lifestyle with an excellent work-life balance.

Average Rent of 1 BHK In Marathahalli-₹12,000- ₹22,000
Average Rent of  2 BHK In Marathahalli-₹27,000-₹35,0000

Lifestyle Amenities:

  • Shopping centers: KLM Fashion Mall, Brookefield Mall.
  • Numerous dining options cater to diverse tastes.
  • Good Schools: VIBGYOR High School, New Horizon Gurukul.
  • Healthcare: Jeevika Hospital, Kauvery Hospital.
